A PostScript letter
Dear reader, this page was written in PostScript and distilled by Ghostscript.
Widthshow stretches every space by two points here.
Ashow letterspaces each glyph.
Kerned: AVA
Monospace: 0123456789 {braces} [brackets]
Rotated thirty degrees
Rotated ninety degrees
Accents via StandardEncoding: caf´e
α β γ δ ∞ ≥

Second page, oblique.
